name: Skip final JPEG round trip
hypothesis: Keep v001 coordinate cropping and final uint8 canvas unchanged, but feed that RGB canvas directly to tensor preparation instead of materializing a PIL image, JPEG encoding, and JPEG decoding it. This should save a small amount of latency with possible quality impact from removing JPEG compression.
changes: Use final_canvas directly as the final RGB input tensor source; omit final PIL materialization and JPEG encode/decode.

quality_policy.gate: same cohort, no failures, and no MAE, RMSE, or per-photo absolute-error regression; microbatch smoke results are not a quality conclusion
